quarterly_data.quarter: Giantec Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 601.92 million, up 4.71% YoY and a record for the first half; Q2 revenue RMB 32,192.72 ten-thousand, up 14.98% QoQ, the best Q2 on record. Net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 525.33 million (+156.07%), largely from a fair-value gain of about RMB 47,124.69 ten-thousand on shares received in another company's STAR Market IPO strategic placement; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 93.47 million (-47.30%). R&D spending was 21.44% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 601.92 million (+4.71%); Q2 revenue RMB 32,192.72 ten-thousand (+14.98% QoQ); recurring net profit RMB 93.47 million (-47.30%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Giantec Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (half-year report): DDR5 SPD chips are now the memory-module product line's main revenue source. In servers, an AI server typically deploys more than 20 DDR5 memory modules, about 2 times a conventional general-purpose server, and the commercial launch of SOCAMM2 modules designed for AI servers opens new incremental room for DDR5 SPD. In PCs, tight memory-die capacity and sharply higher prices pressured demand and PC DDR5 SPD shipments fell; on combined volume and price effects, DDR5 SPD sales revenue declined YoY in H1 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: AI server: more than 20 DDR5 modules, about 2 times a general-purpose server; DDR5 SPD revenue down YoY in H1 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Giantec Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (half-year report): from Q2 2026, with some end markets recovering and SOCAMM2 and LPCAMM2 DDR5 modules entering commercial use, shipments of DDR5 SPD chips and automotive / industrial high-reliability EEPROMs grew quickly versus Q1, lifting blended gross margin about 4.79 percentage points QoQ. To meet demand growth and shortage risk, the company increased purchases of goods (operating cash flow fell 41.63%).
quarterly_data.figure: gross margin up about 4.79 percentage points QoQ in Q2 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Giantec Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Content per module (half-year report, JEDEC DDR5): RDIMM, LRDIMM and MRDIMM modules for general-purpose and AI servers each carry 1 SPD chip and 2 TS chips; SOCAMM2 modules for AI servers carry 1 SPD chip; PC modules (UDIMM, SODIMM, CUDIMM, CSODIMM, CAMM2, LPCAMM2) carry 1 SPD chip. The company co-developed its DDR5 SPD chip with Montage Technology, in wide use at the major memory-module makers since Q4 2021, and is one of few suppliers qualified to supply the major module makers directly.
quarterly_data.figure: 1 SPD + 2 TS per server RDIMM/LRDIMM/MRDIMM; 1 SPD per SOCAMM2 module

quarterly_data.quarter: Giantec Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (half-year report): working with the leading global memory maker that leads the EDSFF standard, the company launched VPD chips for new-generation EDSFF eSSD modules and CXL memory modules; they passed the target customer's test certification in H1 2026 and will be mounted on the customer's module samples distributed to end customers for validation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Giantec Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other lines (half-year report): automotive- and industrial-grade EEPROM, NOR Flash and NFC chip shipments grew quickly YoY; automotive EEPROMs entered several leading global Tier-1 suppliers and are used in 16 of the global top-20 car brands and all of China's top-20 brands; industrial EEPROMs are used in communication base stations / servers including high-speed optical modules. Smartphone EEPROM and open-loop camera-motor driver sales fell as memory costs pressured handset makers.
quarterly_data.figure: 16 of the global top-20 car brands
